thread:
maria: Heads-up — critical tokenization crash in EU-West. Patch branch ready (hotfix/tokenizer-3.2.1). Affects ~1% of requests causing retry storms during long sequences. Need accelerated staging -> canary -> prod flow.
kevin: Severity? rollout window?
maria: P1 for affected customers. Patch fixes memory leak in tokenizer lib. Planning minimal smoke tests only, aiming to avoid full e2e to save time. Change window: immediate, low-traffic slot.
josh: Recommend standard canary first. Suggest start canary at 5% in eu-west, sit 15m, then decide ramp. Who approves rapid pipeline bypass?
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued: repo=repo/inference branch=hotfix/tokenizer-3.2.1 commit=abcdef12 image=sha256:4d2f... Canary plan: staging smoke -> eu-west canary 5% -> ramp steps [25%, 50%]. Healthchecks: /health, tokenization-smoke, tail logs.
sre-oncall: I can approve a short canary. Rollback criteria I want logged: error rate >0.5% absolute increase, 2xx rate below 99.5%, or p95 latency increase > 1200ms over baseline. If any of these tripped, immediate rollback.
product-lead: We need this live ASAP for impacted users. Approving canary.
kevin: Approve pin to version v3.2.1-hotfix for this rollout. Waiving full test matrix; limited smoke only. @deploy-bot start canary.
deploy-bot: Starting canary: target=eu-west1 canary=5% start_ts=2410246830. Running health checks and smoke suite. Logs: https://logs.redwood/example/abcdef12
maria: Smoke outputs (tail):
```
SMOKE tokenization/test_short: PASS
SMOKE tokenization/test_long: PASS (p95 +12ms)
/health: OK
```
josh: Nice. Keep eyes on vendor retry buckets — last incident had a vendor-specific spike.
deploy-bot: Canary at 5%: elapsed=12m metrics: error_rate=0.12% (baseline 0.10%), p95_latency=+50ms. No solid fail triggers. Recommendation: ramp to 25%.
sre-oncall: I vote ramp to 25%. Continue 30m observation window. Rollback criteria still in effect.
deploy-bot: Ramping canary to 25% at ts=2410246910.
sre-oncall: Pause — seeing small spike in retries from a subset of downstream vendors (ids: vendor-a, vendor-c). Spike localized, not system-wide.
maria: Not hitting rollback thresholds yet. Spike looks like degraded TCP connections at vendor edge, isolated to vendor-a. Suggest pause ramp, keep canary at 25% and gather full traces for 20m.
josh: Agreed. Hold ramp. We'll collect traces and decide next step. If vendor issue persists, rollback will be considered.
kevin: For the record: current deployed image pinned at v3.2.1-hotfix on canary 25% in eu-west. No prod-wide roll yet. Approvals logged. :white_check_mark:
product-lead: Thanks everyone. Please update incident if we need to either rollback or resume ramp.
deploy-bot: Canary stabilized at 25% (ts=2410246925). Monitoring continues.
